measurement: same droplet_ground scene at balanced quality, native production route, warm compiler cache, no video

metric_definitions.water_separation_p01_ratio: 1st percentile of nearest same-phase water-particle distance divided by effective spacing
metric_definitions.close_water_particle_fraction: fraction of water particles whose nearest water neighbour is closer than 0.75 times effective spacing
metric_definitions.water_density_p99_ratio: 99th percentile of final SPH density divided by rest density
metric_definitions.height_p90_minus_p10_m: descriptive final particle-height spread; closed world bounds and splash particles affect it

interpretation: The v4 short-range contact projection removes the measured near-coincident water pairs in this regression scene.
The density quantile and iteration-limit rate check pressure convergence separately from particle separation.
The height spread is descriptive, not a volume-conservation metric; a small splash population and invisible world-bound projection can change it.
Nominal represented volume is particle count times spacing cubed and is inventory only, not reconstructed occupied volume.
